input.quote: Vendor may audit Customer at any time without notice and may remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.
input.rationale: Unlimited, unannounced audits with remote access to our systems is expressly walk-away territory, and it also contradicts 22.2's bar on direct system access. We have limited audits to once per 12 months on 30 days' notice, in business hours, through an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, and removed system access; the cost allocation (Vendor pays unless underpayment exceeds 5%) in 22.2 already meets our preferred position.

input.quote: Customer shall pay Vendor USD 25,000 per day as agreed liquidated damages for any delay in providing a dependency.
input.rationale: A USD 25,000 per day penalty on us, triggered by any dependency delay however minor and with no cap, fails our position that no liquidated damages are payable by Customer and is walk-away territory. We have deleted it; Vendor retains schedule relief and can recover demonstrable standby costs.

input.quote: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Meets our preferred position: professional and workmanlike performance (19.1), 90-day Deliverable conformance plus term-long hosted conformance (19.2), compliance-with-law and no-malicious-code warranties (19.3), and re-perform/repair/replace with refund fallback that is expressly non-exclusive (19.4). The 19.5 disclaimer expressly does not limit the express warranties, indemnities or data-protection duties.
